data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
Remediation for bf1e DD1: dispatch wiring missing.

## Description
The components exist but the integration does not:
- copy.artifact_dir config key documented in dso-config.conf.example
- copy_artifact_path.py exposes resolve_artifact_path()
- gov-copy-writer.md accepts {artifact_path} input parameter
- Story-decomposer auto-creates copy stories with gov-copy-writer dispatch (8517 in progress)

What's missing: orchestration glue that, when /dso:sprint dispatches gov-copy-writer for a copy story, (1) reads copy.artifact_dir from dso-config.conf (default 'copy/'), (2) calls 'python ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/copy_artifact_path.py <artifact_dir> <epic_id>' for validated resolved path, (3) injects that path as {artifact_path} into the gov-copy-writer Task tool prompt.

Implementation location: Add a dispatch helper at plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md or a sprint-side script that resolves the artifact path before gov-copy-writer dispatch. Test with end-to-end fixture confirming a non-default [copy] artifact_dir in dso-config.conf causes the artifact to land at the configured location.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] sprint dispatch wiring reads copy.artifact_dir and calls copy_artifact_path.py before gov-copy-writer dispatch
  Verify: grep -rE 'copy_artifact_path|copy\.artifact_dir' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/ plugins/dso/scripts/
- [ ] Unit/integration test asserts non-default artifact_dir is honored end-to-end
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-copy-artifact-dispatch.sh || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
data.title: Wire copy.artifact_dir dispatch: sprint reads config + calls copy_artifact_path.py + injects {artifact_path} into gov-copy-writer dispatch
